title: GRAP obligation (rules-as-data)
description: One obligation that a GRAP stage places on one entity type. Every field here is either structural or copied VERBATIM from a hashed source document. Nothing is paraphrased, summarised, or recalled from memory.

entity_types.description: Scope is deliberately ONE entity type. Adding another is out of scope.

triggers_at_stage.description: The GRAP stage ordinal at which this obligation begins to apply. No maximum is encoded here: which stages exist is declared by the corpus, not by this schema or by application code.

label.description: Short human label. May be editorial, because it is never the legal basis for anything. The quote is.

field.description: Name of the site-profile fact this obligation keys on, e.g. has_dust_generating_activity. If the fact is absent from the profile, the resolver MUST return UNKNOWN.

value.description: Value compared against the site fact. Type must suit the operator.

source_doc.description: doc_id of an entry in corpus/sources/manifest.json. Must exist or verification fails.

page.description: 1-indexed page of the source document on which `quote` appears.

quote.description: VERBATIM text from the cited page. `make verify` re-checks this string appears in the extracted page text. A paraphrase breaks verification, which is the point.

issues_parchi.description: Whether triggering this obligation opens a parchi for each rostered worker.

worker_entitlement_ref.description: entitlement_id this obligation routes a displaced worker to. Optional: an obligation may halt work without a separately cited entitlement.
